title: Any recommendations?
hint: Draw a card and roll the die: it decides how you answer. Answer with a real place or thing if you know one.

answers.R: You recommend it — and give a tip.
answers.W: You wouldn't recommend it — say what you'd recommend instead.
answers.D: You don't know it — say what you'd recommend doing.

model.says: I'm new here. Is the café downstairs any good for lunch? I've only got half an hour.
model.R: It's great — I'd **highly recommend** it. I'd **recommend going** before twelve, though: it gets really busy.
model.W: Honestly? I **wouldn't recommend** it — the food's always cold. I'd **recommend** the Vietnamese place round the corner **instead**.
model.D: I've never been, actually. I'd **recommend asking** Anna — she has lunch there every day.

cards.says: I'm taking some clients out to dinner on Friday. I was thinking of the steak place on the main square. Is it any good?
cards.R: Yes, it's lovely — I'd **recommend** it. I'd **recommend booking** ahead, though: on Fridays it's always full.
cards.W: Hmm, I **wouldn't recommend** it for clients — it's really noisy. I'd **recommend** the Italian place by the river **instead**.
cards.D: I've never been, to be honest. I'd **recommend asking** Tom from sales — he takes clients there a lot.

cards.says: Our boiler's broken again! Do you know a good plumber? There's a company with ads everywhere — FixIt 24.
cards.R: We used FixIt 24 last winter — I'd **recommend** them. They came the same day. I'd **recommend calling** first thing in the morning, though.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** them — they charged us a fortune. I'd **recommend** the plumber who did our bathroom **instead**. I'll send you his number.
cards.D: Sorry, no idea. I'd **recommend asking** in the neighbours' group chat — someone always knows a good one.

cards.says: Everyone's talking about that new series on Netflix. Is it any good?
cards.R: Yes! I'd **highly recommend** it. I'd **recommend watching** it with English subtitles, though — they talk really fast.
cards.W: Honestly? I **wouldn't recommend** it — it's really slow. I'd **recommend** Ted Lasso **instead** — it's so funny.
cards.D: I haven't seen it yet. I'd **recommend watching** the trailer first — then you'll know if it's your thing.

cards.says: I've got one free day in your city on Saturday. Everyone says I should go up the tower. Is it worth it?
cards.R: Yes! I'd **highly recommend** it — the view's amazing. I'd **recommend going** early, before the tour groups arrive.
cards.W: Honestly? I **wouldn't recommend** it — the queue's usually about an hour. I'd **recommend** the hill behind the station **instead**: same view, no queue.
cards.D: I've never actually been up there 😅 I'd **recommend joining** a free walking tour — they're usually great.

cards.says: I want to start learning Spanish before my holiday. Is Duolingo any good, or is there something better?
cards.R: I'd **recommend** it — it's fun, and it's free. I'd **recommend doing** ten minutes a day, though, not an hour once a week.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it if you want to speak — you mostly just tap words. I'd **recommend** a few lessons with a tutor **instead**.
cards.D: No idea, I've never tried it. I'd **recommend trying** a few free apps and sticking with the one you like.

cards.says: I'm coming for the conference next week. They want to put me in the big hotel by the station. Is it any good?
cards.R: People from our office often stay there — it's good. I'd **recommend asking** for a room at the back, though: the front is really noisy.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — people from our office always complain: the rooms are tiny. I'd **recommend** the small hotel near the park **instead**.
cards.D: I've never stayed there. I'd **recommend checking** the reviews before they book it.

cards.says: My hairdresser's moved away. There's a salon on the corner near you — is it any good? I don't want to spend a fortune.
cards.R: Yes, I go there — I'd **recommend** it. It's not too expensive. I'd **recommend booking** a week ahead, though.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — they cut way too much off. I'd **recommend** the one near the station **instead**.
cards.D: I've never been — my friend cuts my hair 😅 I'd **recommend going** in and asking how much a cut is first.

cards.says: We've just moved in. Is the supermarket across the road any good, or should we go somewhere else?
cards.R: It's good — I'd **recommend** it. I'd **recommend going** in the morning, though: the fresh bread's gone by lunchtime.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — it's a bit expensive. I'd **recommend** the cheaper supermarket down the road **instead**.
cards.D: Hmm, I don't shop there. I'd **recommend trying** it for a week and seeing what you think.

cards.says: My son needs a laptop for university. He's looking at the cheapest one online. Can you recommend anything?
cards.R: I'd **recommend** the one I've got — it's light and the battery lasts all day. I'd **recommend waiting** for a sale, though.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** the cheapest one — they often break within a year. I'd **recommend** paying a bit more for a good one **instead**.
cards.D: I don't know much about laptops. I'd **recommend asking** in a computer shop — they'll know what he needs.

cards.says: I need a book for my holiday. Everyone's reading that new thriller — is it any good?
cards.R: Yes! I'd **highly recommend** it — I couldn't put it down. I'd **recommend starting** it before you go, though — you won't want to stop.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — the ending's terrible. I'd **recommend** her first one **instead**.
cards.D: I haven't read it 😅 I'd **recommend asking** in a bookshop. The staff are always happy to suggest something.

cards.who: A friend who's just moved here
cards.says: I want to join a gym. There's a big one near my flat — FitZone. Is it any good?
cards.R: I go there — I'd **recommend** it. I'd **recommend going** before work, though: after six it's packed.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — sixty euros a month is a bit much. I'd **recommend** the gym at the sports centre **instead** — it's half the price.
cards.D: I've never been. I'd **recommend asking** for a free trial first.

cards.who: A mum from your child's class
cards.says: We need a birthday cake for Saturday. Can you recommend a bakery? The one in the shopping centre looks a bit boring.
cards.R: I'd **highly recommend** the little bakery near the school — their cakes are amazing. I'd **recommend ordering** a few days ahead, though.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** the one in the shopping centre — ours was really dry. I'd **recommend** the little bakery near the school **instead**.
cards.D: I always buy mine at the supermarket 😅 I'd **recommend asking** in the parents' chat.

cards.says: We're getting a dog! There's a vet clinic on the main road near us — is it any good?
cards.R: Yes, I'd **recommend** it — they're really gentle with nervous dogs. I'd **recommend booking** online, though: it's quicker than phoning.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — they always rush you. I'd **recommend** the one near the park **instead**.
cards.D: We don't have pets, so no idea. I'd **recommend asking** other dog owners in the park — they'll know.

cards.says: My English teacher says I should listen to podcasts. Is 6 Minute English any good? I don't want anything too difficult.
cards.R: Yes, I'd **recommend** it — it's short and the speakers are really clear. I'd **recommend listening** twice: once for the general idea, then again for new words.
cards.W: Honestly? I **wouldn't recommend** it — it's always the same format, so it gets a bit boring. I'd **recommend** an easy podcast about something you love **instead** — football, cooking…
cards.D: I don't really listen to podcasts. I'd **recommend trying** a few and sticking with the one you enjoy most.

cards.says: My phone screen's cracked. There's a little repair shop by the station. Is it any good?
cards.R: Yes, I'd **recommend** it — they fixed mine in an hour. I'd **recommend asking** for the price first, though.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — mine broke again a week later. I'd **recommend** the official service centre **instead**. It's pricier, but they do it properly.
cards.D: I've never used it. I'd **recommend checking** the reviews online — and getting a price first.

cards.says: We need somewhere for the team Christmas party — last year's place was a bit much: fifty euros each! I was thinking of the karaoke bar on King Street. Is it any good?
cards.R: Yes, I'd **recommend** it — it's great fun. I'd **recommend booking** soon, though: everywhere gets booked up in December.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it — it's tiny, we wouldn't all fit. I'd **recommend** the bowling alley **instead** — it's fun and it's pretty cheap.
cards.D: I've never been, to be honest. I'd **recommend asking** the team what they'd like.

cards.says: I just can't sleep — I'm up till two every night. Is that sleep app everyone's talking about any good?
cards.R: Yes, I'd **recommend** it — the sleep stories really work for me. I'd **recommend setting** the sleep timer, though, so it doesn't play all night.
cards.W: I tried it — I **wouldn't recommend** it. It kept me awake! I'd **recommend** a really boring book **instead** 😄
cards.D: I've never tried it, sorry. I'd **recommend talking** to your doctor — being up till two every night isn't good.

cards.says: I want to watch a film in English. Is that new Guy Ritchie film any good?
cards.R: Yes, I'd **recommend** it — it's really funny. I'd **recommend watching** it twice, though — you'll miss half the jokes the first time.
cards.W: I **wouldn't recommend** it for practising your English — everyone talks super fast, with strong accents! I'd **recommend** Paddington **instead**: the English is really clear.
cards.D: I haven't seen it. I'd **recommend starting** with a film you've already seen in Russian.

items: **Can you recommend a good** [dentist / app]? – посоветуешь?
**Thanks for the heads-up!** – спасибо, что предупредил
**A friend recommended it to me.** – мне посоветовал
**I'd recommend** [the one by the station] **instead**. – лучше…

speaking: Think of **two things** you need this month (a present, an app, a series to watch…) and one option you're thinking of for each. Ask your partner: **I'm thinking of … Is it any good?** Your partner answers, you react with the box. Then swap.

Tell your partner about **two things** you tried because someone recommended them. **Who recommended them to you?** Would you recommend them too — why / why not? Your partner asks one question about each.

Your partner is visiting your city for **one day**. Recommend **three things**, from morning to evening, with a tip for each (**I'd recommend …ing**). Your partner asks one question about each place. Then swap.
